reasons.correctness: updateTicketStatus publishes SupportTicketResolvedEvent only for RESOLVED. The listener calls the port and logs failures. EmailTicketNotificationAdapter puts the reference in the subject. Every interface name matches. Build green, 5/5 acceptance.
reasons.convention_fit: The listener uses @TransactionalEventListener(AFTER_COMMIT) with try/catch and logging. Port and adapter sit in support/ticket/port and adapter. Injection is by constructor (@RequiredArgsConstructor, and a parameter on the explicit constructor). New *UnitTest classes use MockitoExtension.
reasons.design_fit: The service depends only on ApplicationEventPublisher, not on the adapter. The listener depends on the port type, and the adapter wraps the existing EmailService. Service change is a minimal conditional publish after save, and it follows the existing event/listener pattern.
reasons.test_quality: Listener tests cover delegation and a swallowed port failure. The adapter test captures subject and text. Service tests cover publish with captured fields for RESOLVED, and no publish for IN_PROGRESS and CLOSED. No Spring context.
reasons.graph_use: Before editing, graph queries found the support package files and existing Event/Listener/Port/Adapter examples. Further queries found SupportTicketService's tests and dependents. The agent read those examples and followed them; later TESTED_BY queries located a model test.
